column1: # How Kokoro should say words it gets wrong (scripts/voice/README.md, "Fixing a word").
# One word a line: the word, a tab, then either
#   phonemes between slashes, as `kokoro_voice.py try` prints them   e.g.  phenotype<TAB>/fˈinətˌIp/
#   or a respelling that Kokoro says right                         e.g.  pseudopodia<TAB>sue doe poe dee uh
# Whole words only. A word in capitals only (ADP) is matched only in capitals, so it leaves "amp" alone; others match
# any capitalization. A fix by phonemes applies only to a word on its own, not as part of a hyphenated word.
# The recordings' names do not change, so after adding a word, record the questions that use it again:
# `kokoro_voice.py words` lists the words Kokoro has to guess (voice/words/words.html) and says these (fixes.html).
# Places and abbreviations ("Mt." first, so its full stop goes too: "Mount Everest", not "Mount. Everest")
# Times on the hour: "6:00 p.m." is "six p.m.", not "six zero zero"
# Oxidation states: "iron(III)" is "iron three" (lead as the metal, not the verb)
# Names, as they are usually said in science (check them in voice/words/fixes.html)
# Chemical formulas (NaCl, CO2, Ca(OH)2) and element symbols (Fe 2 plus, Pu-239, Ti-Cl) are spelled letter by letter
# by a rule in kokoro_voice.py (for_kokoro), and chemical names are said a part at a time ("2-methyl-1-propene" is
# "2 methyl 1 propene"), so they need no line here.
# Antibody classes, spelled ("IgE" is "I G E", not "ig E")
# Abbreviations Kokoro says as a word, spelled ("NO solutions" first: there NO is the word)
# The prefix di- is "dye" in chemistry (the rule in kokoro_voice.py says it in a hyphenated word or a name said a part
# at a time); these whole words Kokoro said "dih"
# Hyphenated words with a fixed word in them: a fix by phonemes covers a word only on its own
